title: Lipa University Library
text: The Lipa University Library opened in 2009 on the ground floor of the main building. Today it covers two floors and has a reading room with 180 seats. The collection holds about 42,000 books and more than 300 journal titles. Most of the collection consists of textbooks in engineering, economics and foreign languages. Students may borrow up to five books for a period of two weeks. Loans are renewed online or at the front desk. The library is open on weekdays from 8 to 22 and on Saturdays from 9 to 15. During exam periods the reading room is also open on Sundays. On the second floor there are four group study rooms, which are booked one day in advance. Each room has a whiteboard and a screen for presentations. A special collection keeps old manuscripts and maps of the town of Brezovac from the nineteenth century. The collection was donated to the university by the Šarić family. The manuscripts never leave the building, but they have been digitised and are available on the computers in the reading room. Every autumn the library organises an open week for secondary school pupils.
